bundle.shortDescription: Analytical compiler for neural network architectures
bundle.longDescription: NEURAX analyses a neural network architecture before it is trained: parameters, FLOPs, memory, latency, cost, energy and carbon, across a database of accelerators. The desktop build runs the whole compiler on your machine — no account, no upload, no network.
